summary: Executed backend + frontend verification for organization split across login, auth scoping, admin user scoping, deposit data isolation, and org label presence. Core requested split/isolation features passed on public preview URL; optional auth-hardening playbook checks exposed gaps.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts; valid login still returns 200 immediately.

minor.issue: No app-issued auth cookie observed; only Cloudflare __cf_bm HttpOnly cookie present.
Response has access-control-allow-origin='*' and missing access-control-allow-credentials in observed preflight response; explicit credentialed-origin posture not met.
Existing admin documents are updated without reconciling password_hash, so ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes are not applied to already-seeded admins.

action_items: Implement failed-attempt tracking and lockout/rate-limit policy for /api/auth/login after 5 failures.
If cookie-based auth is required by policy, set an app-issued HttpOnly/Secure auth cookie (not relying on edge cookies).
Set explicit CORS origin allowlist with credential support instead of wildcard behavior.
Make admin seed idempotent for password updates by reconciling existing admin password_hash when env password changes.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is a very large monolith (>3000 lines), increasing regression risk and slowing focused changes; should be split into routers/services/modules.
Password hashing path uses bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=12), which is compatible with expected $2b$ bcrypt format.
Frontend export title logic prepends organization_name in ExportReportButtons; UI confirmed export controls are present on current-year report flow.
test_credentials: Read and used /app/memory/test_credentials.md accounts: admin_takaful/admin_union with Admin@123.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary TEST deposit in social-solidarity during backend isolation test and deleted it in same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Requested org-split features validated as working: org buttons, correct/wrong-org login behavior, scoped admin users, and cross-org deposit isolation (union delete returns 404). UI login for admins currently routes directly to admin page (expected due requires_2fa_setup branch), so tests should allow both home/admin post-login destinations.
rca of the issue: RCA: Login handler verifies credentials and immediately issues token without failed-attempt persistence/check, so no lockout occurs. CORS middleware is configured with default wildcard origins; observed preflight does not satisfy explicit credentialed-origin expectation. ensure_default_admin updates existing admin metadata but does not update password_hash, leaving ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes unapplied for existing seeded admins. NOTE: Official Egyptian Tax Authority e-invoice submission is MOCKED (internal JSON/PDF flow) and was not validated as a live external integration in this run.
